title: What GOTCHA knows
description: Where it learned about your business, and the questions it could not answer.
unavailable: We couldn't read your knowledge just now.

counters.sources: {count, plural, =0 {No sources yet} =1 {One source} other {# sources}}
counters.stale: {count, plural, =0 {All refreshed in the last {days} days} =1 {1 not refreshed in {days} days} other {# not refreshed in {days} days}}
counters.undated: {count, plural, =1 {1 source has no last-read date} other {# sources have no last-read date}}
counters.conflicts: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing answered two ways} =1 {1 answered two ways} other {# answered two ways}}
counters.noConfidence: GOTCHA doesn't record how sure it is of what it already knows — that score exists only on suggestions, before you accept them.

conflicts.heading: Answered more than one way
conflicts.unavailable: We couldn't read these just now. This doesn't mean there are none.
conflicts.neverScanned: Nothing has looked for contradictions yet. This runs when past conversations are imported, and that hasn't happened for this workspace — so this isn't “nothing disagrees”, it's “nobody has checked”.
conflicts.none: Nothing in what we read contradicted itself.
conflicts.noneScanned: Nothing in what we read on {when} contradicted itself.
conflicts.asked: {count, plural, =1 {Came up once} other {Came up # times}}
conflicts.meanwhile: Nobody has decided which of these is right, so GOTCHA has both.
conflicts.coverage: These come from reading past conversations — each answer is one your team actually gave, not something written on your website or in a document. Nothing has compared your website against your files; that check doesn't exist yet.

resolve.armed: Press again to save it. GOTCHA will answer customers with the text above.
resolve.alreadyApproved: This was already approved, so nothing was written twice.

use.in_use: Saved. GOTCHA answers with this from now on.
use.not_retrievable: Saved to your knowledge base, but GOTCHA cannot use it yet — preparing it for search failed. Nothing will answer with it until that is retried.
use.unknown: Saved to your knowledge base. We could not confirm it is ready for GOTCHA to use yet.

problem.already_covered: Your knowledge base already answers this, so nothing was added. This suggestion is marked as covered and will not come back as a conflict.
problem.no_knowledge_base: There is no knowledge base to save this into yet. Create one first, and then this will have somewhere to go.
problem.not_found: This suggestion is no longer there. Someone may have decided it already — reload to see where it stands.
problem.forbidden: You do not have permission to change the knowledge base. Whoever administers GOTCHA for you can do this or grant it.
problem.too_long: One of these answers is too long to save as it stands. Shorten it in the knowledge base after approving a shorter one, or edit it there directly.
problem.failed: We could not save that just now, and nothing was written. Try again in a moment.

gaps.heading: Questions it couldn't answer
gaps.none: Nothing has been asked that GOTCHA couldn't answer.
gaps.unavailable: We couldn't read the unanswered questions just now.
gaps.asked: Asked {times, plural, =1 {once} other {# times}} by {people, plural, =1 {one person} other {# people}}

sources.heading: Where it learns from
sources.noneBody: Until something is, GOTCHA answers only from what an AI employee was told directly.
sources.unavailable: We couldn't read the sources just now.
sources.sameName: another source has this name too
sources.documents: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing in it} =1 {One document} other {# documents}}
sources.pending: {count, plural, =1 {One document is still being read, so it isn't answering anything yet} other {# documents are still being read, so they aren't answering anything yet}}
